CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.are_friends(a uuid, b uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from friendships
    where status = 'accepted'
      and ((requester_id = a and addressee_id = b) or (requester_id = b and addressee_id = a))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_forum_report()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  update forum_posts
  set report_count = report_count + 1,
      is_hidden = case when report_count + 1 >= 5 then true else is_hidden end
  where id = new.post_id;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, role)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.email), 'warga');
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_on_announcement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link)
  select id, 'pengumuman', 'Pengumuman Baru: ' || new.title, left(coalesce(new.content, ''), 140), '/pengumuman'
  from profiles;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_on_chat_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link)
  values (
    new.receiver_id,
    'pesan',
    'Pesan Baru',
    left(new.content, 100),
    '/chat/' || new.sender_id::text
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_on_emergency()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link)
  select id, 'darurat', 'Laporan Darurat Baru', 'Ada laporan darurat di lingkungan, cek detailnya.', '/darurat'
  from profiles
  where id != new.reported_by;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_on_friend_request()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'pending' then
    insert into notifications (user_id, type, title, body, link)
    select
      new.addressee_id,
      'pertemanan',
      'Permintaan Pertemanan Baru',
      coalesce((select full_name from profiles where id = new.requester_id), 'Warga') || ' ingin berteman denganmu',
      '/warga/' || new.requester_id::text;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
